scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:go
scripts.build:worker: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-worker ./cmd/kin-worker
scripts.build:egress: mkdir -p bin && cd worker && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o ../bin/kin-egress ./cmd/kin-egress
scripts.build:kernel: mkdir -p bin && cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/kin-kernel/Cargo.toml && cp crates/kin-kernel/target/release/kin-kernel bin/kin-kernel
scripts.build:codex-kernel: mkdir -p bin && cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/codex-kernel/Cargo.toml && cp crates/codex-kernel/target/release/kin-codex-kernel bin/kin-codex-kernel
scripts.test:kernel: cargo test --manifest-path crates/kin-kernel/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path crates/codex-kernel/Cargo.toml
scripts.format: biome format --write && gofmt -w worker && pnpm -C web format
scripts.format:check: biome format && node scripts/check-gofmt.mjs && pnpm -C web format:check
